gold.title: Gold prices steady as markets await Fed signals
gold.summary: Spot gold held near recent highs on Tuesday as traders weighed the odds of a rate move at the Federal Reserve's next meeting, with safe-haven demand offsetting a firmer dollar.

dollar.title: Dollar index holds near key level ahead of data
dollar.summary: The dollar index hovered close to a two-week high as investors positioned ahead of upcoming inflation figures that could shape the path of interest rates.
